title: A Handful for the Display Case
request: Draw k books at random for the case, and no book twice — if the cart holds fewer than k books, take the whole cart. Deliver the total loans of the books you drew.
objective: Sample rows without replacement while respecting the size of the table.
hints: Left to itself, sample draws with replacement, so the same book can walk into the case twice.
Asking for more rows than the cart holds is refused outright when repeats are forbidden.
Take the smaller of k and the cart's row count, sample that many rows with with_replacement set to False, and total the loans column.

import random
from datascience import Table, make_array
titles = ['Lanterns of the Slow Tide', 'The Brass Hour', 'Nine Ways to Fold a Map', 'Eleven Rooms of Rain', 'Winter Comes to the Aviary', 'The Index of Small Storms']
n = random.randint(2, 6)
picked = random.sample(titles, n)
loans = random.sample(range(3, 60), n)
shelf = Table().with_columns('title', make_array(*picked), 'loans', make_array(*loans))
k = random.randint(1, 5)
